question: How did Missy Maxwell Wharton overcome her belief that she could not write after being told so by her eighth grade teacher?
transcript_excerpt: A film producer questioned Missy's assumption that she couldn't write, telling her that grammar does not prevent great storytelling and that editors exist to handle technical issues. With editorial support, her book became a number one bestseller in every category and received over 17 literary awards, which changed her entire perspective on writing capability.

question: What is Light Warrior Publishing and how many number one releases has it achieved since launching?
transcript_excerpt: Light Warrior Publishing was created by Missy Maxwell Wharton after she recognized that self-publishing through traditional publishers charged enormous amounts between 20,000 to 35,000 dollars. The company is only 18 months old but has had 30 number one releases, with several receiving their own literary awards.

question: How many books does a self-published author need to sell to achieve New York Times bestseller status according to current standards?
transcript_excerpt: It no longer takes one million books to be a New York Times bestseller; instead, it takes approximately 10,000 books sold in a surge at one time. One of Missy's authors, a special needs mom, is expected to sell probably 10,000 books right out of the gate from her platform-built audience.

question: What services does Light Warrior Writer Development Program provide to aspiring authors beyond writing feedback?
transcript_excerpt: The Light Warrior Writer Development Program meets on Mondays and Thursdays providing feedback on written work, helping with book design and flow, teaching social media and technology, and offering inner healing support. The program also includes guest authors and connects members to speaking coaches who work with participants twice a month on message delivery.

question: What year did Missy Maxwell Wharton successfully bring home her adopted daughter from Ethiopia after battling a corrupt government official?
transcript_excerpt: Missy and her family touched down on American soil with their adopted daughter on Thanksgiving Eve of 2012 after weeks of legal battles against a corrupt government official who had placed the child in a false foster care system resembling a child trafficking program. The daughter is now 22 years old and has built a beautiful life.
